assessment: Hypersecretion of mucins by colorectal cancer (CRC) cells confers resistance to immune surveillance, and this phenomenon has also been postulated to confer resistance to chemotherapy. This work describes studies aimed at investigating mucus secretion and proteins influencing mucus secretion and the impact on the efficacy of a commonly used chemotherapy treatment. These results shed light on the chemoresistance of mucinous tumors and point to a possible prognostic marker involved in mucus secretion.
